action_items.title: QR Tagging Sequenced After Code Correction
action_items.description: QR tagging will follow asset-record and functional-code correction and ride the incoming maintenance provider's PM cycles.
action_items.log: 09/08/26 — Thomas Dube stated on the call that record and code correction precede tagging and that tagging is not in a rush, superseding item 017-003. Steven Schryba confirmed the CSL gate that no label prints before the code is confirmed stable in writing. The maintenance provider is to be named by 09/11/26. Written confirmation of the structure remains requested.
